hints.title: Verify Monotonic Sum Behavior
hints.text: As the divisor increases, the sum of ceiling divisions monotonically decreases.

hints.title: Compute Division Sum
hints.text: For a chosen divisor d, compute the sum of (x + d - 1) // d across all elements.

hints.title: Search in Range 1 to Max Element
hints.text: Binary search for the smallest divisor in 1 to max(nums) such that the division sum is at most threshold.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every integer divisor from 1 to max(nums) linearly takes O(N * MAX) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search over divisors completes in logarithmic iterations with constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should compute integer ceiling division using (x + d - 1) // d.
